item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -eu
check_file=$(mktemp)
printf '"'{\"service\":{\"retries\":2}}\\n' > \""'$check_file"
node src/cli.js --help
node src/cli.js config-set set "$check_file" service.retries 3
node src/cli.js config-set set "$check_file" service.retries 3 --dry-run
node src/cli.js config-set set "$check_file" service.retries 3
sed -n '"'1,40p' \""'$check_file"
if node src/cli.js config-set set "$check_file" service.retries nope >/tmp/cli-out 2>/tmp/cli-err; then exit 1; fi
[ ! -s /tmp/cli-out ]
sed -n '"'1,3p' /tmp/cli-err
npm test"
